title: Reflex Onboard Snapshots: Compact hints for batching, KV cache, and quantization
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a compact set of onboarding snapshot cards and inline micro-screens for the Optimize toolkit that teach users 3 quick levers: batching configuration, KV prefix caching, and quantization profiles. Deliverables: Figma artboard with responsive cards (desktop/tablet), localized microcopy variants (EN/DE/FR), a short motion prototype for the Console tour, and a screenshot pack for docs and release notes.

acceptance_criteria: All 6 snapshot cards implemented in Figma with desktop and narrow layouts
Microcopy available in English, German, French (stubs for other locales)
Motion prototype demonstrating card-to-card roll animation and CTA interaction
Screenshot pack: 3 sizes (hero wide, console mid, phone narrow) exported in PNG and SVG and uploaded to Drive
Docs PR (optimize quickstart section) created with 3 inline screenshots and matching captions
Engineering verifies runtime keys and quant profiles used in the content
Accessibility: contrast AA, aria-label suggestions included in notes
notes: Design rationale: compact cards lower cognitive load during first-run; callouts focus on measurable economics (est. token cost, latency impact)
Trade-offs discussed with Eng: showing exact cost savings is approximate — we use typical-case estimates with tooltip explaining variability
Future: consider inline playground in Console that applies suggested batch/quant settings to a sample request
